findings.claim: The diff adds 'a finding whose location is not path:line or path:start-end ... is refused' to the help text of 'engine review verify'. That is false. Verify reads the stored result with reviewresult.Parse only (engine/review/app/verify.go:187) and never calls CheckLocations, and the verifier reply holds verdicts, not finding locations. The new test TestCheckStillReadsAStoredResultWhoseLocationHasNoLine in engine/cmd/review_check_test.go needs 'review verify' to exit 0 on a stored result whose location is 'a.txt'. So the help text for verify now says it refuses something it accepts on purpose, and it contradicts S4: the location rule applies only when a reply is recorded, not when a stored result is read again.

Service.Record calls CheckLocations after Parse and wraps the error in ReplyRefusedError (service.go hunk at line 164). The record command maps this to exit 2, which the new review_test.go table case checks.

Parse itself is unchanged, so stored results still parse. TestParseStillAcceptsALocationWithoutALine and the check test pin this.
